# multi-agent-router

Route tasks to specialist agents by rules, lexical intent scores, and optional LLM classifier. Python `multi_agent_router`, MIT licensed. No runtime dependencies.

## Core API

- `Router(agents, rules, llm, fallback, ...)`: Logic engine.
- `AgentSpec(name, description, keywords, handler)`: Definition.
- `AgentReply`: Control handoffs or return text.
- `classify(text)`: Returns `RouteDecision` (agent, stage, score, reason, candidates).
- `dispatch(text)`: Returns `DispatchResult` (status, path, reply).

## Routing Stages

1. Regex Rules (compiled, first match wins, score 1.0).
2. Lexical Scoring (token overlap vs keyword sets, threshold/margin gating).
3. LLM Stage (structured JSON output).
4. Fallback (safe landing on failure).
